en.title: Token Score on a Board
en.description:
A board has n cells. Cell i has value points[i], and its state is T if it holds a token or E if it is empty. Each cell with a token contributes its own value; each pair of adjacent cells that both hold tokens contributes 1 extra point. Find the total score.

This problem uses the standard input/output format compiled by CSWork; the algorithmic rules correspond to the source problem, and the examples and test data are written by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100); the second line contains n integers points[i] (1 ≤ points[i] ≤ 1000); the third line contains a string of length n consisting only of E and T.
en.explanation: In example 1, the tokens are on cells 0, 3, and 4; the base score is 3+2+3=8, and the adjacent pair (3,4) adds 1 more, for a total of 9.
hints: First sum the values of all T cells, then check every pair of adjacent cells to see whether both are T. A run of k consecutive T cells contributes k−1 adjacent pairs, not just one.
